scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: An account alert
scenes.caption: Kabir reviews a supplied sign-in alert. A recognised school-laptop sign-in is followed by an unfamiliar session with a different city label. The new event needs attention, but the city label alone does not identify anyone.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A download follows
scenes.caption: The unfamiliar session downloads the registration file at nine fourteen. At nine twenty, Asha says she does not recognise that session. These observations support a careful response without an accusation about a particular student.
scenes.dialogue: Put the events in order before choosing an explanation.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Facts and hypotheses
scenes.caption: An observation describes what a supplied record says. A hypothesis is a possible explanation to verify. An unsupported conclusion goes beyond the evidence. Location labels can be approximate, and records may not tell the whole story.
scenes.dialogue: Say what we know, and what we still need to check.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Your decision
scenes.caption: The city label differs from the recognised session. Decide what that detail supports. Do not accuse a person or delete evidence. Choose the statement that treats the record proportionately.
scenes.dialogue: What can this clue actually establish?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Initial response
scenes.caption: Preserve relevant details and verify with Asha through a known channel. With the owner, review and revoke unrecognised sessions and secure the account. Inform the responsible teacher about possible data exposure. Urgent containment and escalation may overlap.
scenes.dialogue: We can act calmly without claiming certainty.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the lab
scenes.caption: A clear timeline and evidence ledger are stronger than a guess. In the lab, reconstruct the events, classify three claims and handle a fresh unknown-session case using the stated initial-response sequence.
scenes.dialogue: Let us investigate the evidence, not other students.
